## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it belongs in `ebus-evidence`.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests pass locally or CI is expected to cover the change.
- [ ] New/changed behavior has tests where practical.
- [ ] Public behavior or workflow changes are documented.
- [ ] No generated evidence ZIPs, raw logs, credentials or private handoffs are included.
- [ ] The passive/read-only boundary is preserved: no eBUS writes, adapter control or active probing solely for evidence.
